headline: Obsidian Entertainment pivots from Avowed sequel to new Fallout title
summary: Microsoft's Xbox division is reportedly shifting Obsidian Entertainment's focus to a new Fallout game, canceling multiple projects including a sequel to Avowed.
details: As part of a significant "reset" for Xbox, which includes layoffs and studio restructuring, Obsidian Entertainment is changing its development priorities. The studio, known for games like Grounded and The Outer Worlds, is now reportedly starting work on a new Fallout title.

This shift means the cancellation of multiple projects, including a sequel to last year's RPG Avowed. The Avowed sequel was reportedly in good development and was expected to be announced within the next year.

Josh Sawyer, director of Fallout: New Vegas and Pentiment, is expected to lead the development of the new Fallout game. He was reportedly already directing an RPG with structural and thematic similarities to Fallout, but not part of the franchise.

Despite the success of the Fallout TV series, Xbox has not released a new game in the franchise since Fallout 76 in 2018. Obsidian still plans to continue work on the early access game Grounded 2 and DLC for The Outer Worlds 2.
The news comes as Xbox laid off approximately 25 percent of Obsidian's staff this week. A spokesperson for Xbox declined to comment on the reported changes.
caption:
Obsidian Entertainment is reportedly shifting gears from its Avowed sequel to develop a new Fallout game, as part of a broader Xbox restructuring.

As part of a significant "reset" for Xbox, which includes layoffs and studio restructuring, Obsidian Entertainment is changing its development priorities. The studio, known for games like Grounded and The Outer Worlds, is now reportedly starting work on a new Fallout title.

This shift means the cancellation of multiple projects, including a sequel to last year's RPG Avowed. The Avowed sequel was reportedly in good development and was expected to be announced within the next year.

Josh Sawyer, director of Fallout: New Vegas and Pentiment, is expected to lead the development of the new Fallout game. He was reportedly already directing an RPG with structural and thematic similarities to Fallout, but not part of the franchise.

Despite the success of the Fallout TV series, Xbox has not released a new game in the franchise since Fallout 76 in 2018. Obsidian still plans to continue work on the early access game Grounded 2 and DLC for The Outer Worlds 2.

The news comes as Xbox laid off approximately 25 percent of Obsidian's staff this week. A spokesperson for Xbox declined to comment on the reported changes.
